message.content: {"question": "Select the correct definition of dissociation degree of a solute in a solution.", "options": {"A": "The fraction between moles of dissociated solute and initial moles of solute.", "B": "The weight fraction of original solute molecules that have dissociated.", "C": "The difference between final moles of solute particles in solution and initial moles of solute.", "D": "The fraction between dissociated and undissociated moles of solute."}, "correct": "A"}
